name: Option A — NMC + Al conduction plate, 0.95C
description: Same cells; potted onto an aluminium plate that forms the enclosure base, 6 NTCs at the thermal centre, 0.95C charge (just under the cell's 4.9 A limit) with derating.

assumptions.text: Al plate + thermal pad gives effective h=12 W/m²K per cell surface to ambient
